subject: Post-call: Arkwell pilot MPA & decision owners (recap + next steps)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@arkwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: Arkwell pilot MPA & decision owners (recap + next steps)

Hi Aisha (and team),

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the candid run-through of Arkwell's priorities. Below is a short recap of what we heard, the proposed Mutual Action Plan (MPA) milestones, owners, and a couple of open items we flagged on the call. Please confirm or correct anything that’s off.

Why Arkwell is exploring Redwood
- Need sub-200ms inference for user-facing classification to avoid impacting conversion funnel.
- Current provider has high per-token costs and unpredictable latencies at peak.
- Regulatory concern: data residency + auditable access logs for a single-tenant pilot.

Top goals for the pilot (30–60 days)
- Validate latency SLO (p95 < 200ms) on a 5k QPS-equivalent workload
- Prove 3x reduction in inference cost/token compared to current baseline
- Demonstrate secure VPC deployment with integration to Arkwell KMS and audit exports

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (draft milestones & owners)
1) Scoping & contract alignment — Target complete: 2026-07-23 — Owner: Aisha (Arkwell) + Ben (Redwood sales)
2) Security and compliance checklist + evidence exchange — Target complete: 2026-07-30 — Owner: Devon (Arkwell) + Marissa (Redwood CS) — includes SOC2 artifact handoff and KMS integration details
3) Pilot deployment (private VPC) + load test — Start: 2026-08-03, End: 2026-08-17 — Owner: Marissa (Redwood) + Arkwell infra engineer (TBD)
4) Evaluation & decision review — Complete by: 2026-08-24 — Owner: Aisha (Arkwell) + Ben (Redwood) — decision criteria: latency, cost delta, compliance checklist

Open questions from call
- Which Arkwell team will own infra work (we noted an infra engineer but don’t have a name).
- Any internal procurement windows / approval gates we should factor into the 8/24 review?
- Are there minimum SLAs or commercial terms that Arkwell requires for the pilot to be considered?

Attachments: I’ve attached a one-page MPA spreadsheet (arkwell-mpa-v1.xlsx) with the milestones above and a stub list of required security artifacts.

Next steps
- Ben to send contract redline template (Ben will share EULA/PO terms by 07/16).
- Aisha to confirm infra owner + procurement windows by 07/20.
- Redwood (Marissa) to provision a private test pool and share pre-flight checklist by 07/29.

If that all looks right, I’ll update the MPA (sheet) and Ben will kick off the procurement thread once we have the infra owner.

Thanks — talk soon.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: arkwell-mpa-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 page)
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@arkwell.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@arkwell.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:17:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Arkwell pilot MPA & decision owners (recap + next steps)

Jonas — thanks for capturing this so clearly. Quick confirmations and clarifications from our side: 

Confirmations
- Goals & milestones look accurate. The timeline is aggressive but acceptable if procurement and infra ownership are clear.
- We require a private VPC deployment for the pilot (no shared tenancy).

Clarifications / asks
- Procurement: We have a monthly procurement cutover on the 20th — if we can get commercial terms before 07/20 that would keep things moving quickly.
- Infra owner: I’ll loop in our infra lead, Devon (cc’d). Devon — can you confirm if you can allocate a single engineer for the pilot (estimated 3–5 days across the pilot window)?
- Security: We will need a copy of any SOC2 + access log export examples to share with our internal auditors.

I’ll aim to confirm the infra owner and procurement constraints by 07/20. If Redwood can share the SOC2 evidence stub now, that would help speed our internal review.

Best,
Aisha Patel
VP, Product Operations | Arkwell Technologies
aisha.patel@arkwell.com | +1 (617) 555-0124
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@arkwell.com>, Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@arkwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Arkwell pilot MPA & decision owners (recap + next steps)

Thanks Aisha — appreciate the quick reply and helpful context. A few updates inline and one small ask: 

1) Procurement timing — Ben will attach a one-page commercial summary and our standard pilot terms by 07/16 to give your procurement team a head start prior to your 07/20 cutover.

2) SOC2 & logs — Marissa is cc’d; we can provide a sanitized SOC2 summary and a sample audit log export today. I’m adding an item to the MPA for evidence exchange (target 07/30).

3) Infra owner — Devon, if you can confirm availability for 3–5 days across the 08/03–08/17 window that would be ideal. If you need a narrower window we can accommodate.

Action items (updated)
- Ben (Redwood) — commercial summary + pilot terms by 2026-07-16.
- Aisha (Arkwell) — confirm infra owner and procurement gate by 2026-07-20.
- Marissa (Redwood) — prepare SOC2 stub and sample access log export (delivered 2026-07-15).
- Jonas (Redwood) — update MPA and send revised sheet after Ben’s commercial doc (target 2026-07-17).

I’ll attach the updated MPA once Ben shares the commercial summary.

On the logistics side, do you have a preferred channel for the infra access setup (VPN + temporary service account) or should Marissa propose the standard flow we use for VPC pilots?

— Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@arkwell.com>, Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@arkwell.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Arkwell pilot MPA & decision owners (recap + next steps)

Hi Aisha / Devon — looping in the standard VPC onboarding checklist here to make the infra work straightforward. To confirm: we’ll propose the standard Redwood private VPC flow (temporary service account + short-lived VPN) unless you prefer a direct peering approach. Either works, but peering adds procurement steps on your side.

I’m attaching the SOC2 summary and a sample (sanitized) access-log export for your auditors (arkwell-security-evidence-stub.pdf). That doc includes the fields our logs capture and typical retention options.

Next operational milestones from CS side
- Pre-flight checklist & VPC creds exchange — target 2026-07-29 — Owner: Marissa (Redwood) + Devon (Arkwell)
- Pilot provisioning complete — target 2026-08-02 — Owner: Marissa (Redwood)
- Load test execution — 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-07 — Owner: Marissa (Redwood) + Arkwell infra

If Devon can confirm the infra owner and preferred onboarding channel today or tomorrow we’ll lock the pre-flight window. Otherwise we’ll default to the temporary VPN flow and proceed.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
